false_assurance_cause: in both Gen49 false-assurance cases the instruction was present. The receipt was earned by a visible check narrower than the task: one test file in IP1-r1-C, and in IP1-r3-D a suite that passed while the requirement was inverted

minimal_candidate_invariant.caveat: this would end runs sooner, not make them more correct; on IP1-r1-C it would have stopped a run that was already wrong
minimal_candidate_invariant.name: quiescent_completion
minimal_candidate_invariant.statement: when a valid visible receipt exists for the current tree digest and K consecutive provider requests produce no repository mutation, the run has nothing left to do

retrieval_evidence: none. In all five failures the relevant public information was in the live context or in a file the agent had already read; no case required anything that had aged out of the window

timeout_cases.observable_stop_signal: a receipt that is valid for the current tree digest, plus N further requests with no repository mutation. Both quantities are already computed and recorded by harness-state-v1; neither needs the hidden verifier
